assets.source: Original vector artwork authored for this repository. Editable source: docs/scripts/generate-style-visuals.py (pairing_body), which also writes the inline copy in docs/data/style-visual-examples.yml (examples images-pairing-steps and images-pairing-steps-alt). Run python3 docs/scripts/generate-style-visuals.py to change it; do not edit the SVG by hand.
assets.status: Instructional artwork, not a screenshot or evidence of a live device state. The device is a generic door sensor, not a real product.
assets.background: Fixed illustration colours: White behind 3 Blue tint 80% panels. Does not change with the household theme colour.
assets.purpose: Show a physical task, pressing and holding a door sensor's pairing button until its light flashes, as 3 pictures of the same device. Shown on /styles/images-illustrations.html and, with its alt text, on /styles/images-alt-text.html, where its caption gives only the steps.
assets.alt_decision: Informative. Alt text, as the SVG title only, in one sentence: 'The pairing button is the round white button on the front of the door sensor, with a small light above it.' The steps, including when the light flashes, are in the visible caption, so the alt text does not repeat them.
